rule.metric_cs: net_excluding_best_winner / max(max_drawdown, 1000), on the arm's trades in the window
rule.score: plateau_cs: the median CS on A_select of the arm and its exit neighbours (same entry; one step on exactly one axis: lock TIGHT-LIVE-LATE-OFF, time stop 30-45-75, trail 0.6-1.0-1.5)
rule.rank: eligible arms by plateau_cs desc, then green_week_share desc, then red_days asc, then name
rule.recommend: the first ranked arm that passes the check; if none passes, keep CURRENT
rule.if_recommended: broker-free live shadow + nightly replay on sessions after the freeze; no paper or live change in the proving week; promotion is the owner's call on forward evidence
